capabilities: Track contact cadence and overdue status per person
Remind about birthdays in the next 30 days
Store gift ideas and conversation topics on contact cards
Search and filter contacts by name, phone, topic, or status
extras: Requires Obsidian 1.7.2 or newer; contacts are scanned only from the configured folder and must carry relationship_radar: true frontmatter.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to track who to stay in touch with, when contact is overdue, or upcoming birthdays across notes.
summary: Personal relationship tracker and social CRM that manages contacts in Markdown notes with cadence tracking, birthday reminders, and interaction logs.
